Priya (AE): Heads up — Aurelia Health EoT 2026-12-01. They're asking we reset the pricing baseline for renewal. Current commit 500k/yr but usage spiked ~2.5x during POC. Need Deal Desk on a special tier + PO/payment terms. Any immediate blockers?

Evan (CS): They loved the infra improvements. Asking for a price cap + phased discount ramp. Sent draft SOW and PO ref `PO-2026-0042`. They want clarity on billing slabs and refund language. :eyes:

Liam (DealDesk): Can someone drop the usage histogram + month-by-month run rate? We need to model slab vs unit price. Also flagging security questionnaire — they'll want data residency & logging answers before we commit.

Priya (AE): Uploading CSV to the ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ZD-4238 (security Q attached). They mention VPC/on-prem possibility later. Legal also called out a PO mismatch: PO shows net 60 but standard is net 30. Deal Desk ticket created: DD-98765. :moneybag:

DealDeskBot: New Deal Desk request DD-98765 created by Priya — priority: high — approvers: Liam, Asha, Morgan. Link: https://internal.redwood/deals/DD-98765

Asha (Legal): Net60 is possible with an addendum: include late fee clause and a revenue recognition note. For any pricing-reset we require an amendment signed prior to renewal and a 30-day signature window.

Diego (SE): POC notes: dedicated 4x pod config reduced latency and token cost; performance delta justifies higher sustained usage. Recommend a temporary step-down discount schedule: 15% first quarter, 10% second quarter, then revert to new baseline. I'll draft the SOW paragraph and drop it in the ticket.

Morgan (Finance): Quick margin check: proposed 15% + baseline shift pushes unit below our floor for current commit. Need either a margin waiver or a higher commit. Suggest counter: 12% initial discount + 2-3% runway over 12 months or a 24-36 month commit.

Priya (AE): Customer pushing for 1-year with price cap for 12 months and a floor on usage (min monthly). They'll sign amendment + PO if we can guarantee that. Any flexibility on the floor/waiver?

Liam (DealDesk): I'll slot DD-98765 for the daily Deal Desk sync 9am PT tomorrow. Please attach the CSV, Diego's SOW paragraph, and a suggested price table before EOD. @Asha — prelim okay on net60 subject to addendum?

Asha (Legal): Prelim OK. Add the "payment default remedies" clause and an explicit data-residency statement: "US-only unless otherwise agreed in writing."

Priya (AE): Thanks all — updating DD-98765 with the docs now and will ping once SOW + price table are in. cc @DealDeskBot :rocket:

Evan (CS): FYI customer also asked about an eval metric we used during POC — I'll paste the runbook snippet in the ticket (latency p95, token/sec).

Liam (DealDesk): Great — with those artifacts we can propose: 1) 12% initial discount, 2) usage floor clause, 3) net60 addendum, 4) 12-month price cap. Will present to approvers tomorrow.

Priya (AE): Copy. If deal desk approves, I'll draft the amendment and route to Aurelia for signature.

Morgan (Finance): If you get pushback on commit length, escalate to me — we can carve a short-term margin protection (one-off fee) to keep economics neutral.

Priya (AE): Perfect — thanks team. Updating ticket now.
